<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#040b18">
<title>Rastreamento de Cargas — DF e Entorno</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#040b18; --surface:rgba(8,26,52,.78); --surface2:rgba(3,14,32,.88); --line:rgba(70,150,255,.30);
  --ink:#e6f4ff; --muted:#86aacc; --teal:#27e6ff; --amber:#ffb547; --red:#ff5a6a; --blue:#3d8bff;
  --glow:rgba(39,230,255,.38);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth; scroll-padding-top:84px;}
body{margin:0; min-height:100vh; color:var(--ink); font-family:-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  background:
    radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 50% -10%, rgba(30,90,200,.38), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(rgba(70,150,255,.05) 1px,transparent 1px) 0 0/42px 42px,
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(70,150,255,.05) 1px,transparent 1px) 0 0/42px 42px,
    var(--bg);
  background-attachment:fixed;}
header{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:10; display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:18px; padding:12px 22px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(4,16,36,.96),rgba(4,16,36,.8)); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); backdrop-filter:blur(6px); box-shadow:0 6px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45);}
header h1{font-size:19px; margin:0; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:.4px; text-shadow:0 0 14px var(--glow);}
header h1 .accent{color:var(--teal);}
nav{display:flex; gap:6px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap;}
nav a{color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; font-size:12.5px; padding:6px 13px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid transparent;}
nav a:hover{color:var(--teal); border-color:var(--line); background:rgba(39,230,255,.07);}
.hright{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;}
.datetag{font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); text-transform:capitalize;}
#clock{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-size:16px; color:var(--teal); text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--glow);}
.tag{font-size:12px; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:20px; background:rgba(39,230,255,.12); color:var(--teal); font-weight:650; border:1px solid rgba(39,230,255,.3);}
.tag.live::before{content:""; display:inline-block; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--teal); margin-right:6px; box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--teal); animation:blink 1.6s infinite;}
.tag.bad{color:var(--red); background:rgba(255,90,106,.12); border-color:rgba(255,90,106,.35);}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:.35}}

.wrap{max-width:1640px; margin:0 auto; padding:18px;}
.dash{display:grid; grid-template-columns:280px minmax(0,1fr) 330px; gap:16px; align-items:start;}
.col{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; min-width:0;}
.row2{display:grid; grid-template-columns:280px minmax(0,1fr); gap:16px; margin-top:16px; align-items:start;}
@media (max-width:1180px){
  .dash{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} .col-center{grid-column:1/-1; grid-row:1;} .row2{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  header{grid-template-columns:1fr auto;} nav{grid-column:1/-1; order:3; justify-content:flex-start;}
}
@media (max-width:760px){ .dash{grid-template-columns:1fr;} .wrap{padding:12px;} .datetag{display:none;} }

.panel{position:relative; background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:4px; padding:16px;
  box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(20,80,200,.12) inset, 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35); backdrop-filter:blur(3px);}
.panel::before{content:""; position:absolute; inset:-1px; pointer-events:none; border-radius:4px; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px var(--teal));
  background:
    linear-gradient(var(--teal),var(--teal)) top left/16px 2px,
    linear-gradient(var(--teal),var(--teal)) top left/2px 16px,
    linear-gradient(var(--teal),var(--teal)) top right/16px 2px,
    linear-gradient(var(--teal),var(--teal)) top right/2px 16px,
    linear-gradient(var(--teal),var(--teal)) bottom left/16px 2px,
    linear-gradient(var(--teal),var(--teal)) bottom left/2px 16px,
    linear-gradient(var(--teal),var(--teal)) bottom right/16px 2px,
    linear-gradient(var(--teal),var(--teal)) bottom right/2px 16px;
  background-repeat:no-repeat;}
.panel h3, .filters h2, .form h2, #editGate h2{margin:0 0 12px; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:.9px; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--teal); text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--glow); display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:8px;}
.hint{font-size:11px; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:0; text-transform:none; color:var(--muted); text-shadow:none; text-align:right;}

.filters label,.form label{display:block; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); margin:10px 0 5px;}
.filters select,.filters input,.form select,.form input{width:100%; padding:8px 9px; background:var(--surface2); border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); border-radius:4px; font-size:13.5px;}
.filters select:focus,.filters input:focus,.form select:focus,.form input:focus{outline:none; border-color:var(--teal); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(39,230,255,.18);}
select option{background:#061428; color:var(--ink);}

.kpis{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:10px;}
.kpi{background:var(--surface2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-left:3px solid var(--teal); border-radius:4px; padding:12px 12px 10px;}
.kpi .n{font-size:24px; font-weight:700; text-shadow:0 0 14px var(--glow);}
.kpi .l{font-size:10.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:3px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.6px;}
.kpi.ok{border-left-color:var(--teal);} .kpi.ok .n{color:var(--teal);}
.kpi.amber{border-left-color:var(--amber);} .kpi.amber .n{color:var(--amber);}
.kpi.blue{border-left-color:var(--blue);} .kpi.blue .n{color:var(--blue);}
.kpi.wide{grid-column:1/-1;} .kpi.wide .n{font-size:21px;}

.mappanel{padding-bottom:14px;}
.mapbox{position:relative; width:min(100%,470px); aspect-ratio:769/1047; margin:4px auto 0;}
.mapbox img{width:100%; height:100%; display:block; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(255,150,70,.22));}
#markers{position:absolute; inset:0;}
.mk{position:absolute; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); border-radius:50%; border:2px solid currentColor; padding:0; display:grid; place-items:center;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.25),rgba(0,10,25,.55)); color:var(--teal); font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700;
  box-shadow:0 0 14px currentColor, inset 0 0 10px currentColor; transition:transform .15s, opacity .2s;}
.mk span{color:#fff; text-shadow:0 0 6px #000;}
.mk.amber{color:var(--amber);} .mk.red{color:var(--red);}
.mk.empty{color:#5d7fa3; box-shadow:none; opacity:.75;}
.mk::after{content:""; position:absolute; inset:-6px; border-radius:50%; border:1.5px solid currentColor; opacity:0; animation:pulse 2.4s infinite;}
.mk.empty::after{display:none;}
@keyframes pulse{0%{transform:scale(.7); opacity:.7;} 100%{transform:scale(1.55); opacity:0;}}
.mk:hover,.mk:focus-visible{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.12); outline:none;}
.mk.sel{outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:4px;}
.mk.dim{opacity:.35;}
.tip{position:absolute; z-index:4; min-width:160px; padding:9px 11px; background:rgba(3,14,32,.96); border:1px solid var(--teal); border-radius:6px; box-shadow:0 0 18px var(--glow);
  font-size:12px; line-height:1.55; pointer-events:none; opacity:0; transition:opacity .12s; transform:translate(-50%,calc(-100% - 26px)); white-space:nowrap;}
.tip.below{transform:translate(-50%,26px);}
.tip.on{opacity:1;}
.tip b{color:var(--teal); font-size:12.5px;}
.zonelegend{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr)); gap:8px; margin-top:14px;}
.zchip{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; text-align:left; width:100%; background:var(--surface2); color:var(--ink); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:4px; padding:8px 10px; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600;}
.zchip:hover{border-color:var(--teal);} .zchip.sel{border-color:var(--teal); box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--glow) inset;}
.zchip small{display:block; color:var(--muted); font-size:11px; font-weight:400; margin-top:1px;}
.dot{width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; box-shadow:0 0 8px currentColor; flex-shrink:0; color:var(--teal); font-style:normal;}
.dot.amber{color:var(--amber);} .dot.red{color:var(--red);} .dot.empty{color:#5d7fa3; box-shadow:none;}

.region-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin:9px 0; font-size:13px;}
.region-row .name{width:118px; color:var(--muted); flex-shrink:0; font-size:12px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.region-row .bar-track{flex:1; height:8px; background:var(--surface2); border-radius:5px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line);}
.region-row .bar-fill{height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--teal)); box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--teal);}
.region-row .val{width:82px; text-align:right; color:var(--muted); flex-shrink:0; font-size:11.5px;}

table{width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:13px;}
th{text-align:left; color:var(--muted); font-weight:600; font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.7px; text-transform:uppercase; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); position:sticky; top:0; background:#071a34;}
td{padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(70,150,255,.14); vertical-align:middle;}
tbody tr:hover{background:rgba(39,230,255,.06);}
.tablewrap{overflow-x:auto; max-height:460px; overflow-y:auto;}
.tag.status{padding:3px 9px; border-radius:20px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; border:none;}
.tag.ok{background:rgba(39,230,255,.14); color:var(--teal);}
.tag.late{background:rgba(255,90,106,.15); color:var(--red);}
.tag.transit{background:rgba(61,139,255,.16); color:var(--blue);}
.tag.pending{background:rgba(255,181,71,.15); color:var(--amber);}
.cv{width:100%;} canvas{width:100%; display:block;}
.empty{color:var(--muted); font-size:13px; padding:20px 0; text-align:center;}
button{cursor:pointer; border:none; border-radius:4px; padding:9px 12px; font-size:13px; font-weight:650; font-family:inherit;}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--teal)); color:#00131f; width:100%; margin-top:12px; box-shadow:0 0 16px var(--glow);}
.btn-primary:disabled{opacity:.6; cursor:wait;}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--muted); width:100%;}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--teal); color:var(--teal);}
.del{background:transparent; color:var(--red); font-size:12px; padding:4px 8px; border:1px solid rgba(255,90,106,.35);}
.readonly-note{font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:10px; line-height:1.5;}
.form textarea{width:100%; padding:8px 9px; background:var(--surface2); border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); border-radius:4px; font:inherit; font-size:13.5px; resize:vertical;}
.form textarea:focus{outline:none; border-color:var(--teal); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(39,230,255,.18);}
.obs-col{min-width:210px; max-width:300px;}
.obs-txt{white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink);}
.obs-edit{width:100%; min-width:200px; padding:5px 7px; background:var(--surface2); border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); border-radius:4px; font:inherit; font-size:12.5px; resize:vertical;}
.obs-edit:focus{outline:none; border-color:var(--teal); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(39,230,255,.18);}
.st-edit{padding:4px 8px; border-radius:20px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; font-family:inherit; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface2); color:var(--ink); cursor:pointer;}
.st-edit.ok{color:var(--teal); border-color:rgba(39,230,255,.5); background:rgba(39,230,255,.10);}
.st-edit.late{color:var(--red); border-color:rgba(255,90,106,.5); background:rgba(255,90,106,.10);}
.st-edit.transit{color:var(--blue); border-color:rgba(61,139,255,.55); background:rgba(61,139,255,.12);}
.st-edit.pending{color:var(--amber); border-color:rgba(255,181,71,.5); background:rgba(255,181,71,.10);}
.st-edit:disabled,.obs-edit:disabled{opacity:.5; cursor:wait;}
#toast{position:fixed; right:18px; bottom:18px; z-index:20; max-width:340px; padding:10px 14px; background:rgba(3,14,32,.96); border:1px solid var(--teal); border-radius:6px; box-shadow:0 0 18px var(--glow); font-size:13px; opacity:0; transform:translateY(8px); transition:opacity .2s, transform .2s; pointer-events:none;}
#toast.on{opacity:1; transform:none;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <h1>Rastreamento de Cargas <span class="accent">· DF e Entorno</span></h1>
  <nav>
    <a href="#sec-mapa">Mapa</a><a href="#sec-indicadores">Indicadores</a><a href="#sec-motoristas">Motoristas</a><a href="#sec-atraso">Atraso Mensal</a><a href="#sec-notas">Notas Fiscais</a><a href="#sec-edicao">Modo edição</a>
  </nav>
  <div class="hright">
    <span class="datetag" id="dateTag"></span>
    <span id="clock">--:--:--</span>
    <span class="tag" id="statusTag">conectando…</span>
  </div>
</header>
<div class="wrap">
<div class="dash">

  <div class="col col-left">
    <div class="panel" id="sec-indicadores">
      <h3>Indicadores</h3>
      <div class="kpis" id="kpis"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel filters">
      <h2>Filtros</h2>
      <label>Buscar Carregamento</label>
      <input id="fCarregamento" type="text" placeholder="Ex: 9021">
      <label>Buscar NF</label>
      <input id="fNf" type="text" placeholder="Ex: 48213">
      <label>Macrozona</label>
      <select id="fZona"><option value="">Todas</option></select>
      <label>Bairro / Região Administrativa</label>
      <select id="fRegiao"><option value="">Todas</option></select>
      <label>Status</label>
      <select id="fStatus">
        <option value="">Todos</option>
        <option value="ok">Entregue no prazo</option>
        <option value="late">Entregue com atraso</option>
        <option value="transit">Em trânsito</option>
        <option value="pending">Pendente</option>
      </select>
      <label>Motorista</label>
      <select id="fMot"><option value="">Todos</option></select>
      <label>Ano</label>
      <select id="fAno"><option value="">Todos</option></select>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="col col-center">
    <div class="panel mappanel" id="sec-mapa">
      <h3>Mapa de Cargas — DF e Entorno <span class="hint" id="mapHint">Clique num ponto para filtrar</span></h3>
      <div class="mapbox" id="mapbox">
        <img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="769" height="1047" alt="Mapa do DF e Entorno">
        <div id="markers"></div>
        <div class="tip" id="mapTip"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="zonelegend" id="zoneLegend"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="col col-right">
    <div class="panel">
      <h3>OTD (On Time Delivery)</h3>
      <div class="cv"><canvas id="gauge" height="150"></canvas></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel" id="sec-motoristas">
      <h3>Ranking de Motoristas <span class="hint">entregas no prazo</span></h3>
      <div class="cv"><canvas id="barChart" height="180"></canvas></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel">
      <h3>Pendências por Bairro/RA</h3>
      <div id="regions"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="row2">
  <div class="panel" id="editGate">
    <span id="sec-edicao"></span>
    <h2>Modo edição</h2>
    <div id="gateLocked">
      <label style="display:block; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); margin:10px 0 5px;">PIN de edição</label>
      <input id="pinInput" type="password" placeholder="••••" style="width:100%; padding:8px 9px; background:var(--surface2); border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); border-radius:4px; font-size:13.5px;">
      <button class="btn-ghost" id="btnUnlock" style="margin-top:12px;">Entrar</button>
    </div>
    <div id="formPanel" class="form" style="display:none; margin-top:8px;">
      <label>Número do Carregamento</label>
      <input id="in_carregamento" type="text" placeholder="Ex: 9021">
      <label>Número da NF</label>
      <input id="in_nf" type="text" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="Ex: 48301">
      <label>Bairro / RA</label>
      <select id="in_regiao"></select>
      <label>Motorista</label>
      <input id="in_motorista" type="text" placeholder="Nome do motorista">
      <label>Valor (R$)</label>
      <input id="in_valor" type="text" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="Ex: 3200 ou 3.200,50">
      <label>Status</label>
      <select id="in_status">
        <option value="ok">Entregue no prazo</option>
        <option value="late">Entregue com atraso</option>
        <option value="transit">Em trânsito</option>
        <option value="pending">Pendente</option>
      </select>
      <label>Mês</label>
      <select id="in_mes"></select>
      <label>Ano</label>
      <input id="in_ano" type="number" placeholder="Ex: 2026" min="2000" max="2100">
      <label>Observação</label>
      <textarea id="in_observacao" rows="3" placeholder="Opcional — ex: cliente ausente, reentrega agendada"></textarea>
      <button class="btn-primary" id="btnSalvar">Salvar NF</button>
      <div id="saveMsg" class="readonly-note" style="min-height:18px;"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="readonly-note">Link público: qualquer pessoa vê o painel ao vivo. Só quem tiver o PIN consegue lançar/editar NFs.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="col">
    <div class="panel" id="sec-atraso">
      <h3 id="lineTitle">Atraso Mensal (%)</h3>
      <div class="cv"><canvas id="lineChart" height="200"></canvas></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel" id="sec-notas">
      <h3 id="tableTitle">Notas Fiscais</h3>
      <p id="editHint" class="readonly-note" style="display:none; margin:0 0 10px;">Modo edição ativo: altere o <b>status</b> na lista suspensa e a <b>observação</b> clicando no texto — salva ao sair do campo (Esc cancela, Ctrl+Enter salva).</p>
      <div class="tablewrap">
        <table>
          <thead><tr><th>Carreg.</th><th>NF</th><th>Bairro/RA</th><th>Motorista</th><th>Valor</th><th>Status</th><th>Observação</th><th>Mês</th><th>Ano</th><th></th></tr></thead>
          <tbody id="tbody"></tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
</div>

<div id="toast" role="status"></div>
<script type="module">
/* ======================================================================
   CONFIGURAÇÃO DO FIREBASE
   ====================================================================== */
const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: "AIzaSyAYcAWcV_iDJNJiZpQsAbTP93WwF_JOQfE",
  authDomain: "rastreamento-de-cargas-d20d0.firebaseapp.com",
  projectId: "rastreamento-de-cargas-d20d0",
  storageBucket: "rastreamento-de-cargas-d20d0.firebasestorage.app",
  messagingSenderId: "114429895544",
  appId: "1:114429895544:web:62609ed30c7c190dd6de8d",
  measurementId: "G-JY8E8BJT16"
};

// PIN simples só para esconder o formulário de quem não deveria editar.
// Não é segurança forte — a proteção real de escrita fica nas Regras do Firestore.
const EDIT_PIN = "1507";

import { initializeApp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.0/firebase-app.js";
import { getAuth, signInAnonymously } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.0/firebase-auth.js";
import {
  getFirestore, collection, doc, setDoc, deleteDoc, onSnapshot, serverTimestamp, updateDoc
} from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.0/firebase-firestore.js";

const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const auth = getAuth(app);
const db = getFirestore(app);
const notasRef = collection(db, "notas");

const REGIOES = [
  "Plano Piloto","Gama","Taguatinga","Brazlândia","Sobradinho","Planaltina (DF)","Paranoá","Núcleo Bandeirante",
  "Ceilândia","Guará","Cruzeiro","Samambaia","Santa Maria","São Sebastião","Recanto das Emas","Lago Sul",
  "Riacho Fundo","Lago Norte","Candangolândia","Águas Claras","Riacho Fundo II","Sudoeste/Octogonal","Varjão",
  "Park Way","SCIA/Estrutural","Sobradinho II","Jardim Botânico","Itapoã","SIA","Vicente Pires","Fercal",
  "Sol Nascente/Pôr do Sol","Arniqueira","Arapoanga","Água Quente",
  "Águas Lindas de Goiás (GO)","Cidade Ocidental (GO)","Novo Gama (GO)","Valparaíso de Goiás (GO)",
  "Luziânia (GO)","Formosa (GO)","Planaltina (GO)","Santo Antônio do Descoberto (GO)","Alexânia (GO)",
  "Cristalina (GO)","Padre Bernardo (GO)"
];
const MESES = ["Jan","Fev","Mar","Abr","Mai","Jun","Jul","Ago","Set","Out","Nov","Dez"];
const ZONAS = [
  {id:'df-centro', nome:'DF Centro', x:50.1, y:47.1, regioes:["Plano Piloto","Lago Sul","Lago Norte","Cruzeiro","Sudoeste/Octogonal","Park Way","Varjão","Guará","SIA","SCIA/Estrutural"]},
  {id:'df-oeste', nome:'DF Oeste', x:30.2, y:50.9, regioes:["Ceilândia","Taguatinga","Samambaia","Águas Claras","Vicente Pires","Sol Nascente/Pôr do Sol","Brazlândia","Arniqueira"]},
  {id:'df-sul', nome:'DF Sul', x:44.7, y:53.8, regioes:["Gama","Santa Maria","Recanto das Emas","Riacho Fundo","Riacho Fundo II","Núcleo Bandeirante","Candangolândia"]},
  {id:'df-norte-leste', nome:'DF Norte/Leste', x:69.1, y:46.7, regioes:["Sobradinho","Sobradinho II","Planaltina (DF)","Paranoá","São Sebastião","Itapoã","Fercal","Arapoanga","Água Quente","Jardim Botânico"]},
  {id:'entorno-sul', nome:'Entorno Sul', x:65.1, y:57.5, regioes:["Valparaíso de Goiás (GO)","Novo Gama (GO)","Cidade Ocidental (GO)","Luziânia (GO)","Cristalina (GO)"]},
  {id:'entorno-oeste-norte', nome:'Entorno Oeste/Norte', x:50.7, y:27.0, regioes:["Águas Lindas de Goiás (GO)","Santo Antônio do Descoberto (GO)","Padre Bernardo (GO)","Formosa (GO)","Planaltina (GO)","Alexânia (GO)"]},
];
const ZONA_DE = {}; ZONAS.forEach(z=>z.regioes.forEach(r=>{ ZONA_DE[r]=z.id; }));
function zonaDe(reg){ return ZONA_DE[reg]||''; }
const STATUS_LABEL = {ok:"Entregue no prazo", late:"Entregue com atraso", transit:"Em trânsito", pending:"Pendente"};

const selNf=document.getElementById('fNf'), selRegiao=document.getElementById('fRegiao'),
      selStatus=document.getElementById('fStatus'), selMot=document.getElementById('fMot'), selAno=document.getElementById('fAno'),
      selCarregamento=document.getElementById('fCarregamento'), selZona=document.getElementById('fZona');
ZONAS.forEach(z=>selZona.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<option value="${z.id}">${z.nome}</option>`));
document.getElementById('in_ano').value = new Date().getFullYear();
REGIOES.forEach(r=>selRegiao.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<option value="${r}">${r}</option>`));
const inRegiao=document.getElementById('in_regiao'), inMes=document.getElementById('in_mes');
REGIOES.forEach(r=>inRegiao.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<option value="${r}">${r}</option>`));
MESES.forEach((m,i)=>inMes.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<option value="${i}">${m}</option>`));

let allRows = [];
let canWrite = false;

function esc(t){ return String(t==null?'':t).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }

let toastTimer;
function toast(msg,color){
  const t=document.getElementById('toast'); t.textContent=msg; t.style.borderColor=color||'var(--teal)';
  t.classList.add('on'); clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('on'),2800);
}

function fmtMoney(v){ return "R$ " + Number(v||0).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}); }

// Aceita "3200", "3200,50", "3.200,50", "R$ 3.200" etc. Retorna NaN se for inválido.
function parseValor(txt){
  let s = String(txt||'').trim().replace(/[R$\s]/g,'');
  if(!s) return 0;
  if(s.includes(',')) s = s.replace(/\./g,'').replace(',','.');
  else if(/^\d{1,3}(\.\d{3})+$/.test(s)) s = s.replace(/\./g,'');
  const n = Number(s);
  return isFinite(n) ? n : NaN;
}

const PAGE = 100;
let shown = PAGE;

function populateMotFilter(rows){
  const cur = selMot.value;
  const names = Array.from(new Set(rows.map(r=>r.motorista).filter(Boolean))).sort();
  selMot.innerHTML = '<option value="">Todos</option>' + names.map(n=>`<option value="${n}">${n}</option>`).join('');
  selMot.value = cur;
  const curAno = selAno.value;
  const anos = Array.from(new Set(rows.map(r=>r.ano).filter(Boolean))).sort();
  selAno.innerHTML = '<option value="">Todos</option>' + anos.map(a=>`<option value="${a}">${a}</option>`).join('');
  selAno.value = curAno;
}

function filtered(skipZona){
  const nf=selNf.value.trim(), reg=selRegiao.value, st=selStatus.value, mot=selMot.value, ano=selAno.value, carr=selCarregamento.value.trim(), zona=selZona.value;
  return allRows.filter(d=> (!nf||String(d.nf).includes(nf)) && (!reg||d.regiao===reg) && (!st||d.status===st) && (!mot||d.motorista===mot) && (!ano||String(d.ano)===ano) && (!carr||String(d.carregamento||'').includes(carr)) && (skipZona||!zona||zonaDe(d.regiao)===zona) );
}

function renderKpis(rows){
  const total = rows.length;
  const ok = rows.filter(r=>r.status==='ok').length;
  const late = rows.filter(r=>r.status==='late').length;
  const pending = rows.filter(r=>r.status==='pending').length;
  const transit = rows.filter(r=>r.status==='transit').length;
  const valor = rows.reduce((a,r)=>a+(Number(r.valor)||0),0);
  const cards = [
    [total,"Total de NFs",""], [ok+late,"NFs Entregues","ok"], [pending,"NFs Pendentes","amber"],
    [transit,"Em Trânsito","blue"], [fmtMoney(valor),"Valor Total","wide"],
  ];
  document.getElementById('kpis').innerHTML = cards.map(c=>`<div class="kpi ${c[2]}"><div class="n">${c[0]}</div><div class="l">${c[1]}</div></div>`).join('');
}

function renderRegions(rows){
  const byReg = {}; REGIOES.forEach(r=>byReg[r]={total:0,pending:0});
  rows.forEach(r=>{ if(byReg[r.regiao]){ byReg[r.regiao].total++; if(r.status==='pending') byReg[r.regiao].pending++; } });
  const el = document.getElementById('regions');
  const entries = Object.entries(byReg).filter(([,v])=>v.total>0).sort((a,b)=>b[1].pending-a[1].pending).slice(0,14);
  if(!entries.length){ el.innerHTML='<div class="empty">Nenhum dado para os filtros atuais.</div>'; return; }
  el.innerHTML = entries.map(([reg,v])=>{
    const pct = v.total? Math.round(v.pending/v.total*100):0;
    return `<div class="region-row"><span class="name">${reg}</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div><span class="val">${v.pending} pend. (${pct}%)</span></div>`;
  }).join('');
}

const STATUS_OPTS = ['ok','late','transit','pending'];
function statusCell(r){
  if(!canWrite) return `<span class="tag status ${esc(r.status)}">${esc(STATUS_LABEL[r.status]||r.status)}</span>`;
  return `<select class="st-edit ${esc(r.status)}" data-nf="${esc(r.nf)}" aria-label="Status da NF ${esc(r.nf)}">`
    + STATUS_OPTS.map(s=>`<option value="${s}" ${r.status===s?'selected':''}>${STATUS_LABEL[s]}</option>`).join('') + `</select>`;
}
function obsCell(r){
  if(!canWrite) return r.observacao ? `<span class="obs-txt">${esc(r.observacao)}</span>` : '—';
  return `<textarea class="obs-edit" rows="2" data-nf="${esc(r.nf)}" data-orig="${esc(r.observacao||'')}" placeholder="Adicionar observação…">${esc(r.observacao||'')}</textarea>`;
}
// true enquanto alguém está digitando uma observação ainda não salva (evita apagar o texto num re-render)
function isEditingObs(){
  const ae = document.activeElement;
  return !!(ae && ae.classList && ae.classList.contains('obs-edit') && ae.value!==ae.dataset.orig);
}
function permMsg(e){ return e.code==='permission-denied' ? 'sem permissão — confira as Regras do Firestore e o login Anônimo.' : e.message; }

async function salvarCampo(nf,dados,el){
  el.disabled = true;
  const timer = setTimeout(()=>{ el.disabled=false; toast('Sem resposta do servidor — verifique a internet. A alteração será gravada ao reconectar.','var(--amber)'); },8000);
  try{
    await updateDoc(doc(db,'notas',String(nf)), {...dados, atualizadoEm: serverTimestamp()});
    return true;
  }catch(e){
    alert('Erro ao salvar a alteração da NF '+nf+': '+permMsg(e));
    return false;
  }finally{ clearTimeout(timer); el.disabled=false; }
}

function renderTable(rows){
  const tbody = document.getElementById('tbody');
  document.getElementById('tableTitle').textContent = 'Notas Fiscais (' + rows.length + ')';
  if(!rows.length){ tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10"><div class="empty">Nenhuma NF lançada ainda para esses filtros.</div></td></tr>'; return; }
  let html = rows.slice(0,shown).map(r=>`<tr>
    <td>${esc(r.carregamento)||'—'}</td><td>${esc(r.nf)}</td><td>${esc(r.regiao)}</td><td>${esc(r.motorista)||'—'}</td><td>${fmtMoney(r.valor)}</td>
    <td>${statusCell(r)}</td>
    <td class="obs-col">${obsCell(r)}</td>
    <td>${MESES[r.mes]||'—'}</td>
    <td>${r.ano||'—'}</td>
    <td>${canWrite ? `<button class="del" data-nf="${esc(r.nf)}">Excluir</button>` : ''}</td>
  </tr>`).join('');
  if(rows.length > shown){
    html += `<tr><td colspan="10" style="text-align:center;"><button class="btn-ghost" id="btnMais" style="width:auto;">Mostrar mais (${shown} de ${rows.length})</button></td></tr>`;
  }
  tbody.innerHTML = html;
  const mais = document.getElementById('btnMais');
  if(mais) mais.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ shown += PAGE; renderAll(); });
  if(!canWrite) return;

  tbody.querySelectorAll('.del').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
      if(!confirm('Excluir a NF '+btn.dataset.nf+'?')) return;
      btn.disabled = true;
      try{ await deleteDoc(doc(db,'notas',String(btn.dataset.nf))); }
      catch(e){ btn.disabled=false; alert('Erro ao excluir: '+e.message); }
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('.st-edit').forEach(sel=>{
    sel.addEventListener('change', async ()=>{
      const nf = sel.dataset.nf, novo = sel.value;
      const ok = await salvarCampo(nf,{status:novo},sel);
      if(ok) toast('✔ Status da NF '+nf+' alterado para "'+STATUS_LABEL[novo]+'".');
      else renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('.obs-edit').forEach(t=>{
    t.addEventListener('change', async ()=>{
      const nf = t.dataset.nf, v = t.value.trim();
      const ok = await salvarCampo(nf,{observacao:v},t);
      if(ok){ t.dataset.orig = v; toast('✔ Observação da NF '+nf+' salva.'); }
      else { t.value = t.dataset.orig; }
    });
    t.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
      if(e.key==='Escape'){ t.value = t.dataset.orig; t.blur(); }
      else if(e.key==='Enter' && (e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)){ t.blur(); }
    });
  });
}

function cssVar(name){ return getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue(name).trim(); }

function setupCanvas(id,h){
  const c = document.getElementById(id);
  const w = c.parentElement.clientWidth || 300;
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  c.width = Math.round(w*dpr); c.height = Math.round(h*dpr); c.style.height = h+'px';
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d'); ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0); ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  return {ctx,w};
}
function fitText(ctx,t,maxW){
  t = String(t||'—');
  if(ctx.measureText(t).width<=maxW) return t;
  while(t.length>1 && ctx.measureText(t+'…').width>maxW) t=t.slice(0,-1);
  return t+'…';
}

function drawGauge(rows){
  const {ctx,w} = setupCanvas('gauge',150);
  const ok = rows.filter(r=>r.status==='ok').length, late = rows.filter(r=>r.status==='late').length;
  const pct = (ok+late) ? ok/(ok+late) : 0;
  const cx=w/2, cy=126, radius=Math.min(w/2-26,102);
  ctx.lineCap='round';
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,170,255,.35)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let i=0;i<=20;i++){
    const ang=Math.PI+Math.PI*i/20, r1=radius+13, r2=radius+(i%5===0?22:18);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx+Math.cos(ang)*r1,cy+Math.sin(ang)*r1); ctx.lineTo(cx+Math.cos(ang)*r2,cy+Math.sin(ang)*r2); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.lineWidth=14; ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(70,150,255,.18)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,radius,Math.PI,0); ctx.stroke();
  if(pct>0){
    const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(cx-radius,0,cx+radius,0);
    g.addColorStop(0,cssVar('--blue')); g.addColorStop(1,cssVar('--teal'));
    ctx.shadowColor=cssVar('--teal'); ctx.shadowBlur=16; ctx.strokeStyle=g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,radius,Math.PI,Math.PI+Math.PI*pct); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  }
  ctx.fillStyle=cssVar('--ink'); ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.shadowColor=cssVar('--teal'); ctx.shadowBlur=12;
  ctx.font='700 30px -apple-system,sans-serif'; ctx.fillText((pct*100).toFixed(1)+'%', cx, cy-14);
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.font='12px -apple-system,sans-serif'; ctx.fillStyle=cssVar('--muted');
  ctx.fillText('entregas no prazo', cx, cy+8);
}

function drawBarChart(rows){
  const {ctx,w} = setupCanvas('barChart',180);
  const byMot = {};
  rows.forEach(r=>{ if(!byMot[r.motorista]) byMot[r.motorista]=0; if(r.status==='ok') byMot[r.motorista]++; });
  const arr = Object.entries(byMot).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,6);
  const max = Math.max(1,...arr.map(a=>a[1]));
  ctx.font='12px -apple-system,sans-serif'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  if(!arr.length){ ctx.fillStyle=cssVar('--muted'); ctx.fillText('Sem dados ainda.',0,20); return; }
  const labelW=Math.min(120,w*0.38), barH=18, gap=12, top=8;
  arr.forEach((a,i)=>{
    const y = top + i*(barH+gap);
    const bw = Math.max(2,(w-labelW-40) * (a[1]/max));
    ctx.fillStyle = cssVar('--muted'); ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.fillText(fitText(ctx,a[0],labelW-8), 0, y+barH/2);
    const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(labelW,0,labelW+bw,0); g.addColorStop(0,cssVar('--blue')); g.addColorStop(1,cssVar('--teal'));
    ctx.shadowColor=cssVar('--teal'); ctx.shadowBlur=10; ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(labelW,y,bw,barH); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    ctx.fillStyle = cssVar('--ink'); ctx.fillText(a[1], labelW+bw+8, y+barH/2);
  });
}

function drawLineChart(rows){
  const {ctx,w} = setupCanvas('lineChart',200);
  const H=200;
  const anos = rows.map(r=>Number(r.ano)).filter(Boolean);
  const ano = selAno.value ? Number(selAno.value) : (anos.length ? Math.max(...anos) : new Date().getFullYear());
  document.getElementById('lineTitle').textContent = 'Atraso Mensal (%) — ' + ano;
  const perMonth = MESES.map((_,i)=>{
    const m = rows.filter(r=>r.mes===i && Number(r.ano)===ano);
    const late = m.filter(r=>r.status==='late').length;
    return m.length ? late/m.length*100 : null;
  });
  const padL=34, padB=24, padT=12, plotW=w-padL-14, plotH=H-padB-padT;
  const max = Math.max(10,...perMonth.map(v=>v||0));
  const xy = i=>[ padL + plotW*(i/(perMonth.length-1)), padT + plotH - ((perMonth[i]||0)/max)*plotH ];
  ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,170,255,.16)';
  for(let g=0;g<=3;g++){ const y=padT+plotH*g/3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL,y); ctx.lineTo(padL+plotW,y); ctx.stroke(); }
  ctx.fillStyle=cssVar('--muted'); ctx.font='10.5px -apple-system,sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='right'; ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  ctx.fillText(Math.round(max)+'%',padL-5,padT+4); ctx.fillText('0%',padL-5,padT+plotH+3);
  ctx.strokeStyle=cssVar('--amber'); ctx.lineWidth=2.5; ctx.lineJoin='round';
  ctx.shadowColor=cssVar('--amber'); ctx.shadowBlur=12;
  ctx.beginPath(); let pen=false;
  perMonth.forEach((v,i)=>{
    if(v===null){ pen=false; return; }
    const [x,y]=xy(i);
    if(!pen){ ctx.moveTo(x,y); pen=true; } else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  });
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle=cssVar('--amber');
  perMonth.forEach((v,i)=>{ if(v===null) return; const [x,y]=xy(i); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,3.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); });
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.fillStyle=cssVar('--muted'); ctx.textAlign='center';
  MESES.forEach((mm,i)=>{ const [x]=xy(i); ctx.fillText(mm, x, H-7); });
}

/* ---------- Mapa por macrozona ---------- */
let lastStats = {}, tipZone = '', tipTimer;
function zoneStats(rows){
  const z = {}; ZONAS.forEach(o=>{ z[o.id]={total:0,pending:0,ok:0,late:0,transit:0,valor:0}; });
  rows.forEach(r=>{
    const s = z[zonaDe(r.regiao)]; if(!s) return;
    s.total++; s.valor += Number(r.valor)||0;
    if(r.status in s) s[r.status]++;
  });
  return z;
}
function zoneCls(s){ if(!s.total) return 'empty'; const p=s.pending/s.total; return p>0.5?'red':(p>0.2?'amber':'ok'); }

function renderMap(rows){
  const st = zoneStats(rows); lastStats = st;
  const sel = selZona.value;
  const max = Math.max(1,...Object.values(st).map(s=>s.total));
  const sc = Math.max(.8, Math.min(1, document.getElementById('mapbox').clientWidth/470));
  document.getElementById('markers').innerHTML = ZONAS.map(z=>{
    const s = st[z.id], size = Math.round((24+Math.sqrt(s.total/max)*16)*sc);
    return `<button type="button" class="mk ${zoneCls(s)} ${sel===z.id?'sel':''} ${sel&&sel!==z.id?'dim':''}" data-z="${z.id}" style="left:${z.x}%;top:${z.y}%;width:${size}px;height:${size}px" aria-label="${z.nome}: ${s.total} NFs"><span>${s.total}</span></button>`;
  }).join('');
  document.getElementById('zoneLegend').innerHTML = ZONAS.map(z=>{
    const s = st[z.id];
    return `<button type="button" class="zchip ${sel===z.id?'sel':''}" data-z="${z.id}"><i class="dot ${zoneCls(s)}"></i><span><span class="zn">${z.nome}</span><small>${s.total} NFs · ${s.pending} pend.</small></span></button>`;
  }).join('');
  const zsel = ZONAS.find(z=>z.id===sel);
  document.getElementById('mapHint').textContent = zsel ? 'Filtrando: '+zsel.nome+' — clique de novo para limpar' : 'Clique num ponto para filtrar';
  if(tipZone && document.getElementById('mapTip').classList.contains('on')) showTip(tipZone,false);
}

const tip = document.getElementById('mapTip');
function showTip(id,touch){
  const z = ZONAS.find(o=>o.id===id), s = lastStats[id]; if(!z||!s) return;
  tipZone = id;
  const otd = (s.ok+s.late) ? Math.round(s.ok/(s.ok+s.late)*100)+'%' : '—';
  tip.innerHTML = `<b>${z.nome}</b><br>${s.total} NFs · ${s.pending} pendentes<br>Em trânsito: ${s.transit} · OTD: ${otd}<br>${fmtMoney(s.valor)}`;
  tip.style.left = `clamp(90px, ${z.x}%, calc(100% - 90px))`; tip.style.top = z.y+'%';
  tip.classList.toggle('below', z.y<25);
  tip.classList.add('on');
  clearTimeout(tipTimer); if(touch) tipTimer = setTimeout(hideTip,3000);
}
function hideTip(){ tip.classList.remove('on'); }

function toggleZona(id){ selZona.value = (selZona.value===id) ? '' : id; shown = PAGE; renderAll(); }
const mapbox = document.getElementById('mapbox'), legendEl = document.getElementById('zoneLegend');
[mapbox,legendEl].forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click',e=>{ const b=e.target.closest('[data-z]'); if(b) toggleZona(b.dataset.z); }));
mapbox.addEventListener('pointerover',e=>{ const b=e.target.closest('.mk'); if(b) showTip(b.dataset.z, e.pointerType==='touch'); });
mapbox.addEventListener('pointerout',e=>{ if(e.target.closest('.mk')) hideTip(); });
mapbox.addEventListener('focusin',e=>{ const b=e.target.closest('.mk'); if(b) showTip(b.dataset.z,false); });
mapbox.addEventListener('focusout',hideTip);

function renderAll(){
  populateMotFilter(allRows);
  const rows = filtered();
  renderKpis(rows); renderRegions(rows); if(!isEditingObs()) renderTable(rows); renderMap(filtered(true));
  drawGauge(rows); drawBarChart(rows); drawLineChart(rows);
}
[selNf,selRegiao,selStatus,selMot,selAno,selCarregamento,selZona].forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('input',()=>{ shown=PAGE; renderAll(); }));
window.addEventListener('resize', renderAll);

document.getElementById('btnUnlock').addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
  if(document.getElementById('pinInput').value !== EDIT_PIN){ alert('PIN incorreto.'); return; }
  try{ await signInAnonymously(auth); }catch(e){ alert('Erro ao autenticar: '+e.message); return; }
  canWrite = true;
  document.getElementById('editHint').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('gateLocked').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('formPanel').style.display = 'block';
  renderAll();
});

const saveMsg = document.getElementById('saveMsg');
function setMsg(t,color){ saveMsg.textContent=t; saveMsg.style.color=color||''; }

document.getElementById('btnSalvar').addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
  const nf = document.getElementById('in_nf').value.trim();
  if(!nf){ setMsg('Preencha o número da NF antes de salvar.','var(--red)'); document.getElementById('in_nf').focus(); return; }
  if(nf.includes('/')){ setMsg('O número da NF não pode conter "/".','var(--red)'); return; }
  const valor = parseValor(document.getElementById('in_valor').value);
  if(Number.isNaN(valor)){ setMsg('Valor inválido. Use, por exemplo, 3200 ou 3.200,50.','var(--red)'); document.getElementById('in_valor').focus(); return; }

  const existente = allRows.find(r=>String(r.nf)===nf);
  if(existente && !confirm('A NF '+nf+' já existe (Carreg. '+(existente.carregamento||'—')+', '+(existente.motorista||'sem motorista')+').\nDeseja SUBSTITUIR os dados dela?')){
    setMsg('Salvamento cancelado: a NF '+nf+' já existia.','var(--amber)'); return;
  }

  const obsForm = document.getElementById('in_observacao').value.trim();
  const body = {
    carregamento: document.getElementById('in_carregamento').value.trim(),
    regiao: inRegiao.value,
    motorista: document.getElementById('in_motorista').value.trim(),
    valor: valor,
    status: document.getElementById('in_status').value,
    observacao: obsForm || (existente && existente.observacao) || '',
    mes: Number(inMes.value),
    ano: Number(document.getElementById('in_ano').value) || new Date().getFullYear(),
    criadoEm: (existente && existente.criadoEm) ? existente.criadoEm : serverTimestamp(),
    atualizadoEm: serverTimestamp(),
  };
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnSalvar');
  btn.disabled = true; setMsg('Salvando…');
  const timer = setTimeout(()=>setMsg('Sem resposta do servidor ainda — verifique a internet. Ao reconectar, a NF será gravada.','var(--amber)'), 8000);
  try{
    await setDoc(doc(db,'notas',nf), body);
    document.getElementById('in_carregamento').value=''; document.getElementById('in_nf').value=''; document.getElementById('in_motorista').value=''; document.getElementById('in_valor').value=''; document.getElementById('in_observacao').value='';
    setMsg('✔ NF '+nf+' salva com sucesso.','var(--teal)');
  }catch(e){
    const msg = e.code==='permission-denied' ? 'sem permissão — confira as Regras do Firestore e o login Anônimo no Firebase.' : e.message;
    setMsg('Erro ao salvar: '+msg,'var(--red)');
    alert('Erro ao salvar: '+msg);
  }finally{ clearTimeout(timer); btn.disabled = false; }
});

function tick(){
  const d = new Date();
  document.getElementById('clock').textContent = d.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR');
  document.getElementById('dateTag').textContent = d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{weekday:'short',day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit'});
}
tick(); setInterval(tick,1000);

const statusTag = document.getElementById('statusTag');
onSnapshot(notasRef, snap=>{
  allRows = snap.docs.map(d=>({ nf:d.id, ...d.data({serverTimestamps:'estimate'}) }));
  const t = r => (r.criadoEm && r.criadoEm.toMillis) ? r.criadoEm.toMillis() : 0;
  allRows.sort((a,b)=> t(b)-t(a) || String(a.nf).localeCompare(String(b.nf),'pt-BR',{numeric:true}));
  statusTag.textContent = 'ao vivo'; statusTag.classList.remove('bad'); statusTag.classList.add('live');
  renderAll();
}, err=>{
  statusTag.textContent = 'erro de conexão'; statusTag.classList.remove('live'); statusTag.classList.add('bad');
  console.error(err);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
